company.name: Pirros
company.shortDescription: Pirros is a detail management system for architects and engineers.
company.description: Engineers and Architects end up redesigning hundreds of details a year just because they are unable to search through all their past details. Pirros allows them to effectively manage and search all their past project details so that they can find reasonable starting points rather than starting from scratch.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for managing, searching, organizing, and integrating architectural and engineering details into Revit projects.
productsAndServices.name: Pirros Detail Management System

productsAndServices.description: A tool within Pirros that enables users to locate architectural and engineering details quickly using keywords and metadata filters.

productsAndServices.description: Integration that allows users to move details between Pirros and Autodesk Revit for a streamlined design workflow.
productsAndServices.name: Revit Integration

productsAndServices.description: Features that allow users to group, share, categorize, and manage architectural and engineering details within teams.

productsAndServices.description: Functionality to monitor detail usage and assist in vetting and approving details for inclusion in the firm’s library.
